logp.method_description: The hydrophobicity values of these complexes were expressed in terms of partition coefficient method using‘Shake flask method’ in octanol/water phase partitions as reported elsewhere (Nehru, Veeralakshmi, & Arunachalam, 2017). Definite concentration of complex 1 or 2 (1 mM) was dissolved in a mixture of n-octanol and water (1:1 ratio of 10 mL) followed by mechanical stirring for 1 h. The resultant mixture was allowed to settle for over a period of 30 min and thereupon collected as two separate phases without cross contamination of one solvent layer onto another. The concentration of complexes in each phase was determined by UV–Vis absorption spectroscopy at room temperature. Based on the concentrations of cobalt complex distributed in the biphasic system (n-octanol–water), the partition coefficients (log P) values were calculated using Equation (1) and the attained results are given as the mean values obtained from three independent experiments.
